# Fuse

![Fuse](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/fuse.png)

Discard it to charge +6. Heads spends all charge as points.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 30%
- **Shop price:** 10 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 1 point

## Tails
Nothing

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade)
